style: Dense board-game diorama miniature, elevated three-quarter top-down view, hand-painted texture, crisp tiny details, warm saturated colors, soft drop shadow beneath, transparent background (PNG alpha). images.prompt: A tiny efficiency shrine — a sleek minimalist monolith carved from cool grey-blue stone, about the size of a book, standing upright on a small pedestal. The face has a single thin horizontal aperture that glows with a soft teal light, like a power-save eye. Tiny circuit-etching lines run down the sides, suggesting compressed intelligence. The base is polished marble with a small brass plaque. The overall vibe is 'less is more' — clean, restrained, almost meditative. Whimsical board-game piece style, transparent background.
